statement: Every valid interior update satisfies the per-cell replacement rule.
assume: scores.length >= 1 && slot >= 0 && slot < scores.length && score >= 0 && score <= 2 && (scores.length <= 0 || (scores[0] >= 0 && scores[0] <= 2)) && (scores.length <= 1 || (scores[1] >= 0 && scores[1] <= 2)) && (scores.length <= 2 || (scores[2] >= 0 && scores[2] <= 2)) && slot < scores.length - 1
assert: (scores.length <= 0 || scores[0] == (slot == 0 ? score : \old(scores[0]))) && (scores.length <= 1 || scores[1] == (slot == 1 ? score : \old(scores[1]))) && (scores.length <= 2 || scores[2] == (slot == 2 ? score : \old(scores[2])))
